panels.title: 선택 회차
panels.description: 최근 수신 30초 기준은 이벤트 지연 참고값입니다. 유휴 상태도 표시될 수 있습니다. 수집 통신 장애는 열린 COMM_LOST 알람으로만 표시합니다. Grafana 조회 실패는 패널 오류로 표시됩니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
station_state AS (
  SELECT s.station_code, s.name, s.kind, s.sort_order, e.state, e.started_at, e.ended_at, t.seconds
  FROM station s
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT es.state, es.started_at, es.ended_at
    FROM equipment_state es
    WHERE es.station_code = s.station_code AND es.run_id = r.run_id
    ORDER BY es.started_at DESC, es.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) e ON true
  LEFT JOIN v_equipment_time t
    ON t.station_code = s.station_code AND t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.state = e.state
  WHERE s.line = '2A'
), run_lots AS (
  SELECT c.lot_code, count(*) AS cells
  FROM cell c JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
  GROUP BY c.lot_code
), visible_alarms AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.station_code, a.code, a.severity, a.raised_at, a.acked_at, a.message
  FROM v_alarm_open a
  LEFT JOIN station s ON s.station_code = a.station_code
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  WHERE a.run_id = r.run_id OR (a.run_id IS NULL AND s.line = '2A')
), latest_event AS (
  SELECT e.occurred_at, e.received_at, e.station_code, e.event_type
  FROM selected_run r JOIN event_log e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE e.source = '2A'
  ORDER BY e.received_at DESC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 1
), recent_events AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.occurred_at, e.received_at, e.station_code, e.event_type, e.entity_id
  FROM selected_run r JOIN event_log e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE e.source = '2A'
    AND e.occurred_at >= $__timeFrom() AND e.occurred_at < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 100
), state_history AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.station_code, e.state, e.started_at, e.ended_at
  FROM selected_run r JOIN equipment_state e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  JOIN station s ON s.station_code = e.station_code AND s.line = '2A'
  WHERE e.started_at < $__timeTo()
    AND COALESCE(e.ended_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > $__timeFrom()
  ORDER BY e.started_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 100
), rows AS (
  SELECT 'overview' AS section, -1 AS position, '선택 실행'::text AS item,
         COALESCE(r.run_id::text, '미수집 / 회차 없음') AS state,
         r.started_at AS started, r.ended_at AS ended,
         NULL::numeric AS amount, r.purpose AS detail
  FROM (VALUES (1)) AS anchor(n) LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'overview', s.sort_order, s.station_code || ' · ' || s.name,
         CASE WHEN s.state IS NULL THEN '미수집'
              WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN s.state || ' · 종료'
              ELSE s.state END,
         s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.seconds, s.kind
  FROM station_state s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'lot', 0, l.lot_code, CASE WHEN l.is_held THEN '보류' ELSE '보류 아님' END,
         l.last_held_at, NULL, x.cells,
         format('공용 DB 셀 %s · 최신 전기 NG %s', l.cells, l.confirmed_ng)
  FROM v_lot_status l LEFT JOIN run_lots x USING (lot_code)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'alarm', -a.severity, COALESCE(a.station_code, '회차 공통') || ' · ' || a.code,
         CASE WHEN a.acked_at IS NULL THEN '미확인' ELSE '확인됨' END,
         a.raised_at, a.acked_at, a.severity,
         '#' || a.id::text || COALESCE(' · ' || a.message, '')
  FROM visible_alarms a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'freshness', 0, COALESCE('회차 ' || r.run_id::text, '선택 실행 없음'),
         CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN '미수집 · 회차 없음'
              WHEN r.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN '회차 종료'
              WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_alarms a WHERE a.code = 'COMM_LOST')
                THEN '수집 통신 장애 · 열린 알람'
              WHEN e.received_at IS NULL THEN '미수집 · 이벤트 없음'
              WHEN e.received_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR e.occurred_at > e.received_at
                THEN '시계 확인 필요'
              WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - e.received_at > interval '30 seconds'
                THEN '이벤트 유입 지연 · 연결 미확인'
              ELSE '최근 수신 있음' END,
         e.received_at, e.occurred_at,
         CASE WHEN r.ended_at IS NULL AND e.received_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              THEN floor(extract(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - e.received_at)) END,
         CASE WHEN e.received_at IS NOT NULL THEN
           concat_ws(' · ', e.station_code, e.event_type,
             CASE WHEN e.occurred_at <= e.received_at
                  THEN '발생→DB ' || round(extract(epoch FROM e.received_at - e.occurred_at), 1)::text || '초' END)
         END
  FROM (VALUES (1)) AS anchor(n)
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN latest_event e ON true
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'events', 0, e.station_code, e.event_type, e.occurred_at, e.received_at,
         CASE WHEN e.occurred_at <= e.received_at
              THEN round(extract(epoch FROM e.received_at - e.occurred_at), 1) END,
         concat_ws(' · ', e.entity_id, e.event_id::text)
  FROM recent_events e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'state_history', 0, e.station_code, e.state, e.started_at, e.ended_at,
         floor(extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(e.ended_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - e.started_at)),
         e.id::text
  FROM state_history e
)
SELECT section AS "영역", item AS "항목", state AS "상태", started AS "시각",
       ended AS "종료·확인 시각", amount AS "값", detail AS "상세"
FROM rows
ORDER BY section, position, CASE WHEN section IN ('alarm','events','state_history') THEN started END DESC NULLS LAST, item, detail

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
core AS (
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.result_code IN (1, 2, 3) AND c.status <> 'retest') AS final_pass,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.result_code = 9 AND c.status IN ('rejected','scrapped')) AS final_ng,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'retest') AS retest_pending,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.grade = 'A' AND e.result_code = 1 AND c.status <> 'retest') AS group_a,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.grade = 'B' AND e.result_code = 2 AND c.status <> 'retest') AS group_b,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.grade = 'C' AND e.result_code = 3 AND c.status <> 'retest') AS group_c
  FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
  LEFT JOIN v_cell_electrical_latest e USING (cell_id)
  GROUP BY r.run_id
), retest_attempts AS (
  SELECT c.run_id, count(i.id) AS attempts
  FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
  LEFT JOIN cell_inspection i ON i.cell_id = c.cell_id AND i.kind = 'electrical' AND i.attempt > 1
  GROUP BY c.run_id
), rows AS (
  SELECT m.section, m.position, m.item, m.value, m.unit, m.detail
  FROM (VALUES (1)) AS anchor(n)
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN v_run_yield y ON y.run_id = r.run_id
  LEFT JOIN totals t ON true
  LEFT JOIN retest_attempts a ON a.run_id = r.run_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('production', 1, '셀 투입', y.cells_in::numeric, '셀', '등록 셀 기준'),
    ('production', 2, '외관 NG', y.appearance_ng, '셀', '외관 결과 코드 9'),
    ('production', 3, '1차 전기 PASS', y.first_pass_ok, '셀', '시도 1, 결과 코드 1/2/3'),
    ('production', 4, '최종 전기 PASS', t.final_pass, '셀', '최대 시도, 재검 대기 제외'),
    ('production', 5, '최종 전기 NG', t.final_ng, '셀', '최대 시도 NG, 최종 제거 상태'),
    ('group', 1, 'A', t.group_a, '셀', '셀 특성군·전기 결과 일치'),
    ('group', 2, 'B', t.group_b, '셀', '셀 특성군·전기 결과 일치'),
    ('group', 3, 'C', t.group_c, '셀', '셀 특성군·전기 결과 일치'),
    ('retest', 1, '재검 검사 건수', a.attempts, '건', 'attempt > 1'),
    ('retest', 2, '재검한 셀', y.retested, '셀', '중복 셀 제외'),
    ('retest', 3, '재검 합격', y.retest_recovered, '셀', '팀 실행 수율 정의'),
    ('retest', 4, '재검 대기', t.retest_pending, '셀', '셀 상태 retest'),
    ('retest', 5, '최종 전기 NG', t.final_ng, '셀', '외관 NG 및 재검 대기 제외')
  ) AS m(section, position, item, value, unit, detail)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'tester', v.position, v.station_code, s.tests, '건',
         CASE WHEN s.station_code IS NOT NULL THEN
           format('NG %s · 평균 검사 %s', coalesce(s.ng_pct::text || '%', '미수집'),
             coalesce(s.avg_test_s::text || '초', '미수집')) END
  FROM (VALUES (1,'2A-T1'),(2,'2A-T2'),(3,'2A-T3'),(4,'2A-T4'),(5,'2A-RT')) v(position,station_code)
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN v_tester_stats s ON s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.station_code = v.station_code
)
SELECT section AS "영역", item AS "항목", value AS "수량", unit AS "단위", detail AS "상세"
FROM rows ORDER BY section, position
), inspections AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.kind = 'appearance') AS appearances,
         count(DISTINCT i.cell_id) FILTER (WHERE i.kind = 'appearance' AND i.result_code = 0) AS appearance_pass,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.kind = 'electrical') AS electrical
  FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
  JOIN cell_inspection i ON i.cell_id = c.cell_id AND i.kind IN ('appearance','electrical')
), kit_state AS (
  SELECT b.box_id, b.grade, b.spread_mv,
         b.status IN ('full','handed_over','consumed') AND b.packed_at IS NOT NULL
         AND b.cells = 4 AND count(DISTINCT c.box_slot) = 4
         AND bool_and(c.grade IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.grade AND c.run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.run_id) AS complete
  FROM selected_run r JOIN v_box_spread b ON b.run_id = r.run_id
  LEFT JOIN cell c ON c.box_id = b.box_id
  GROUP BY b.box_id, b.grade, b.spread_mv, b.status, b.packed_at, b.cells
), alarm_state AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN count(a.id) > 0
              THEN count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE open_alarm.id IS NOT NULL)
         END AS open_count
  FROM alarm a LEFT JOIN station s ON s.station_code = a.station_code
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN v_alarm_open open_alarm ON open_alarm.id = a.id
  WHERE a.run_id = r.run_id OR (a.run_id IS NULL AND s.line = '2A')
), tester_state AS (
  SELECT v.station_code, v.position, m."수량", m."상세", stats.ng_pct, stats.avg_test_s,
         CASE WHEN e.state IS NULL THEN '미수집'
              WHEN e.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN '종료: ' || e.state
              ELSE e.state END AS state
  FROM (VALUES (1,'2A-T1'),(2,'2A-T2'),(3,'2A-T3'),(4,'2A-T4'),(5,'2A-RT')) v(position, station_code)
  LEFT JOIN core m ON m."영역" = 'tester' AND m."항목" = v.station_code
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN v_tester_stats stats ON stats.run_id = r.run_id AND stats.station_code = v.station_code
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT e.state, e.ended_at
    FROM equipment_state e
    WHERE e.run_id = r.run_id AND e.station_code = v.station_code
    ORDER BY e.started_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
  ) e ON true
), comparison_cells AS (
  SELECT b.box_id, c.cell_id, c.plc_no, e.ocv_mv
  FROM kit_state b JOIN cell c USING (box_id)
  JOIN v_cell_electrical_latest e USING (cell_id)
  WHERE b.complete AND c.plc_no IS NOT NULL AND e.ocv_mv IS NOT NULL
    AND e.result_code = CASE b.grade WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 3 END
), comparison_kits AS (
  SELECT box_id, max(ocv_mv) - min(ocv_mv) AS spread_mv
  FROM comparison_cells
  GROUP BY box_id HAVING count(*) = 4
), sequence_cells AS (
  SELECT c.ocv_mv, (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.plc_no, c.cell_id) - 1) / 4 AS set_no
  FROM comparison_cells c JOIN comparison_kits b USING (box_id)
), sequence_kits AS (
  SELECT max(ocv_mv) - min(ocv_mv) AS spread_mv
  FROM sequence_cells GROUP BY set_no
), comparison AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS sets, avg(spread_mv) AS kit_avg,
         (SELECT avg(spread_mv) FROM sequence_kits) AS sequence_avg
  FROM comparison_kits
), handoff_per_kit AS (
  SELECT b.box_id, count(h.request_id) > 0 AS has_history,
         bool_or(h.status = 'requested' AND h.released_at IS NULL AND h.confirmed_at IS NULL) AS open_request,
         bool_or(h.released_at IS NOT NULL) AS released,
         bool_or(h.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS confirmed
  FROM kit_state b LEFT JOIN supply_handoff h USING (box_id)
  WHERE b.complete
  GROUP BY b.box_id
), handoff_counts AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(has_history) THEN count(*) FILTER (
           WHERE open_request AND NOT released AND NOT confirmed) END AS waiting,
         CASE WHEN bool_or(has_history) THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE released) END AS released,
         CASE WHEN bool_or(has_history) THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE confirmed) END AS confirmed
  FROM handoff_per_kit
), trace_cell AS (
  SELECT c.cell_id, c.created_at, c.grade, c.box_id, c.box_slot
  FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c USING (run_id)
  WHERE c.cell_id = NULLIF(btrim(${cell_id:sqlstring}), '')
), trace_events AS (
  SELECT c.created_at AS stamp, 0::bigint AS sort_id, '2A-IN'::text AS node,
         '셀 등록'::text AS title, c.cell_id AS detail, NULL::text AS group_name, NULL::smallint AS slot_no
  FROM trace_cell c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.measured_at, i.id, i.station_code,
         CASE i.kind WHEN 'id_read' THEN 'ID 판독' WHEN 'appearance' THEN '외관검사'
                     ELSE '전기검사 · 시도 ' || i.attempt END,
         concat_ws(' · ',
           CASE WHEN i.result_code IN (0,1,2,3) THEN 'PASS'
                WHEN i.result_code = 9 THEN 'FAIL'
                WHEN i.result_code = 5 THEN '미판독/대기' END,
           CASE WHEN i.kind = 'electrical' THEN
             concat_ws(' / ', COALESCE(round(i.ocv_mv / 1000.0, 3)::text || ' V', 'OCV 미수집'),
                              COALESCE(i.ir_mohm::text || ' mΩ', 'IR 미수집')) END,
           '검사 #' || i.id), NULL, NULL
  FROM trace_cell c JOIN cell_inspection i USING (cell_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.packed_at, 0, '2A-BOX', 'Kit 포장',
         concat_ws(' · ', c.box_id, '특성군 ' || c.grade, '슬롯 ' || c.box_slot,
                   CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cell_inspection i WHERE i.cell_id = c.cell_id
                          AND i.kind = 'electrical' AND i.measured_at > b.packed_at)
                        THEN '포장·검사 시각 순서 확인 필요' END), c.grade, c.box_slot
  FROM trace_cell c JOIN cell_box b USING (box_id)
  JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = b.run_id
  WHERE b.packed_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT h.stamp, 0, '2A-OUT', h.title, sh.request_id, NULL, NULL
  FROM trace_cell c JOIN supply_handoff sh USING (box_id)
  JOIN cell_box b ON b.box_id = c.box_id
  JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = b.run_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('인계 요청', sh.requested_at),
                             ('출구 통과', sh.released_at), ('수신 확인', sh.confirmed_at)) h(title, stamp)
  WHERE h.stamp IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.occurred_at, 0, e.station_code, e.event_type, e.event_id::text, NULL, NULL
  FROM trace_cell c JOIN event_log e ON e.entity_id = c.cell_id AND e.source = '2A'
  JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = e.run_id
  WHERE e.station_code IN ('2A-IDC', '2A-SORT', '2A-LA', '2A-LB', '2A-LC', '2A-RJ1', '2A-RJ2')
), trace_steps AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY stamp, sort_id, node, title, detail) AS step_no
  FROM trace_events
), trace_cursor AS (
  SELECT * FROM trace_steps
  WHERE NULLIF(btrim(${trace_step:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR step_no::text = btrim(${trace_step:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY step_no DESC LIMIT 1
), v2_rows AS (
  SELECT "영역" AS area, "항목" AS label,
         CASE WHEN i.electrical = 0 AND ("영역" = 'retest' OR "항목" = '1차 전기 PASS')
              THEN NULL ELSE "수량" END AS amount,
         "단위" AS unit, "상세" AS detail,
         NULL::text AS state, NULL::numeric AS ng_pct, NULL::numeric AS average_s,
         NULL::bigint AS kit_count, NULL::double precision AS spread_v
  FROM core CROSS JOIN inspections i
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'kpi', x.label, x.amount, x.unit, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM inspections i CROSS JOIN alarm_state a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('총 투입 셀', (SELECT "수량" FROM core WHERE "영역" = 'production' AND "항목" = '셀 투입'), '셀'),
    ('외관 PASS', CASE WHEN i.appearances > 0 THEN i.appearance_pass END, '셀'),
    ('외관 NG', CASE WHEN i.appearances > 0 THEN (SELECT "수량" FROM core WHERE "영역" = 'production' AND "항목" = '외관 NG') END, '셀'),
    ('최종 전기 PASS', CASE WHEN i.electrical > 0 THEN (SELECT "수량" FROM core WHERE "영역" = 'production' AND "항목" = '최종 전기 PASS') END, '셀'),
    ('최종 전기 NG', CASE WHEN i.electrical > 0 THEN (SELECT "수량" FROM core WHERE "영역" = 'production' AND "항목" = '최종 전기 NG') END, '셀'),
    ('재검 대기', CASE WHEN i.electrical > 0 THEN (SELECT "수량" FROM core WHERE "영역" = 'retest' AND "항목" = '재검 대기') END, '셀'),
    ('완료 Kit', (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE complete) END FROM kit_state), 'Kit'),
    ('열린 알람', a.open_count, '건')
  ) x(label, amount, unit)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'testers_v2', station_code, "수량", '건', "상세", state, ng_pct, avg_test_s, NULL, NULL
  FROM tester_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'groups_v2', c."항목",
         CASE WHEN i.electrical > 0 THEN c."수량" END, '셀', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kit_state) THEN
             (SELECT count(*) FROM kit_state b WHERE b.complete AND b.grade = c."항목") END,
         (SELECT (avg(b.spread_mv) / 1000.0)::double precision
          FROM kit_state b WHERE b.complete AND b.grade = c."항목")
  FROM core c CROSS JOIN inspections i WHERE c."영역" = 'group'

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'paired_spread', x.label, x.amount, x.unit, NULL, x.state, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM comparison c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('비교 대상 세트', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_run) THEN c.sets END, 'Kit', NULL),
    ('투입 순서 평균 편차', CASE WHEN c.sets >= 2 THEN c.sequence_avg END, 'mV', NULL),
    ('실제 Kit 평균 편차', CASE WHEN c.sets >= 2 THEN c.kit_avg END, 'mV', NULL),
    ('평균 편차 감소율', CASE WHEN c.sets >= 2 THEN
             100 * (c.sequence_avg - c.kit_avg) / NULLIF(c.sequence_avg, 0) END, '%', NULL),
    ('비교 상태', NULL, NULL,
            CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_run) THEN '미수집 · 회차 없음'
                 WHEN c.sets < 2 THEN '비교 불가 · 표본 부족'
                 WHEN c.sequence_avg = 0 THEN '비교 불가 · 기준 편차 0'
                 ELSE '비교 가능' END)
  ) x(label, amount, unit, state)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'handoff', x.label, x.amount, 'Kit', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM handoff_counts h
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('인계 대기 · 요청 접수', h.waiting),
                             ('출구 통과 Kit', h.released), ('팩 라인 수신 확인 Kit', h.confirmed)) x(label, amount)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'trace', title, step_no, NULL, detail, node, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM trace_steps
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'cursor', t.group_name, NULL, NULL,
         CASE WHEN t.step_no IS NOT NULL THEN
           concat_ws('  ·  ', '단계 ' || t.step_no, to_char(t.stamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'HH24:MI:SS'),
                     t.node, t.title, t.detail)
         WHEN btrim(${cell_id:sqlstring}) = '' THEN
           'Cell ID를 입력하면 기록된 지점을 볼 수 있습니다. 단계 번호를 비우면 마지막 기록을 표시합니다.'
         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trace_cell) THEN '미수집 · 해당 단계 기록 없음'
         ELSE '미수집 · 선택 회차에 해당 Cell ID 없음' END,
         t.node, NULL, NULL, t.slot_no, NULL
  FROM (VALUES (1)) a(n) LEFT JOIN trace_cursor t ON true
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'role_rate', metrics.label, metrics.rate, '%', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_code = 9) AS ng,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_code IN (0,9)) AS decided
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.cell_id) ci.result_code
      FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c USING (run_id) JOIN cell_inspection ci USING (cell_id)
      WHERE ci.kind = 'appearance'
      ORDER BY c.cell_id, ci.measured_at DESC, ci.id DESC
    ) latest
  ) appearance
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status <> 'retest' AND latest.result_code IN (1,2,3)) AS recovered,
           count(*) AS retested
    FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c USING (run_id)
    LEFT JOIN v_cell_electrical_latest latest USING (cell_id)
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cell_inspection i WHERE i.cell_id = c.cell_id
                  AND i.kind = 'electrical' AND i.attempt > 1)
  ) retest
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT max("수량") FILTER (WHERE "항목" = '최종 전기 PASS') AS pass,
           max("수량") FILTER (WHERE "항목" = '최종 전기 NG') AS fail
    FROM core WHERE "영역" = 'production'
  ) electrical
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('외관 NG율', 100.0 * appearance.ng / NULLIF(appearance.decided, 0)),
    ('최종 전기 합격률', 100.0 * electrical.pass / NULLIF(electrical.pass + electrical.fail, 0)),
    ('최종 전기 NG율', 100.0 * electrical.fail / NULLIF(electrical.pass + electrical.fail, 0)),
    ('재검 회복률', 100.0 * retest.recovered / NULLIF(retest.retested, 0))
  ) metrics(label, rate)
)
SELECT area AS "영역", label AS "항목", amount AS "수량", unit AS "단위", v.detail AS "상세",
       state AS "상태", ng_pct AS "NG율 (%)", average_s AS "평균 검사 (초)",
       kit_count AS "Kit 수", spread_v AS "평균 Kit 편차 (V)", ts.stamp AS "기록 시각",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-IN' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-IN",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-VIS1' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-VIS1",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-VIS2' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-VIS2",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-T1' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-T1",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-T2' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-T2",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-T3' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-T3",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-T4' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-T4",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-RT' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-RT",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-IDC' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-IDC",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-BOX' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-BOX",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-OUT' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-OUT",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND ((state = '2A-BOX' AND label = 'A') OR state = '2A-LA') THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 그룹 A",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND ((state = '2A-BOX' AND label = 'B') OR state = '2A-LB') THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 그룹 B",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND ((state = '2A-BOX' AND label = 'C') OR state = '2A-LC') THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 그룹 C",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-SORT' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-SORT",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-RJ1' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-RJ1",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-RJ2' THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 2A-RJ2",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-BOX' AND kit_count = 1 THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 slot 1",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-BOX' AND kit_count = 2 THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 slot 2",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-BOX' AND kit_count = 3 THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 slot 3",
       CASE WHEN area = 'cursor' AND state = '2A-BOX' AND kit_count = 4 THEN '●' ELSE ' ' END AS "이력 slot 4"
FROM v2_rows v LEFT JOIN trace_steps ts ON v.area = 'trace' AND ts.step_no = v.amount
ORDER BY area, CASE WHEN area = 'trace' THEN amount END,
         CASE label WHEN '2A-RT' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, label
